findings.detail: 5.4 bundles four distinct save-time rejections (empty surface, empty canonical, within-environment surface->two-roots collision, built-in-root shadow) plus serialise/write/file-unchanged-on-failure in one criterion. Testable but would map 1:1 to tests more cleanly if split into lettered sub-criteria (5.4a..5.4d). Not blocking.

findings.area: The one new mechanism / design clarity
findings.detail: AliasEnvironment is shared between the panel-side state (9.2) and UserAliasRowToml declared alongside AliasRowToml in alias_reader.rs (9.4), but neither section states the enum's defining module or that it is pub(crate) for cross-module reuse. Minor; no behavioural ambiguity. Add one sentence naming its home module.

5.7 packs the third-overlay precedence, per-row environment routing, the no-shadow invariant, and the SAME-root/DIFFERENT-root cross-layer rule into one dense criterion. Correct and consistent with design 9.5, but doing the work of three testable statements. Consider splitting the cross-layer collision behaviour into its own sub-criterion. Not blocking.
